general: Warwick has one of the strongest early games among melee top laners: levels 1-2 are fine, and at level 3 with all three basic abilities he wins almost every melee duel thanks to E's fear and damage reduction, with the passive keeping him around 50% HP all lane. Take Barrier to survive Ignite or execute burst, and expect to turn early ganks into kills with Lethal Tempo. His main risk is getting kited by ranged or mobile champions; Q to cut them off and E to fear them, and from 6 you can ult a healthy ranged laner and chase. First spike is Pickaxe or Vampiric Scepter, and Blade of the Ruined King is one of the best one-item spikes in the game, so contest every minion once you have it. He has no waveclear (buy Tiamat to roam, or Hullbreaker for plates). Mid game, push side lanes and win 1v1s (Stridebreaker helps you stick) or start fights with R; late game he falls off, so close out games through objectives.
